tbesh_html:
1) eminence, perpetuity, strength, victory, enduring, everlastingness
1a) eminence
1b) enduring of life
1c) endurance in time, perpetual, continual, unto the end
1d) everlastingness, ever

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: alway(-s), constantly, end, ([phrase] n-) ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.
